idempotencyKey.description: Optional; a repeat within 5 minutes returns the cached response.

input.description: What to send the widget's brain: {"message": "..."} (or a plain string) for an agent or chatflow brain; the workflow inputs for a workflow brain.

response.description: The brain's result; for an agent brain {content, conversationId}.

snippets.curl:
# Call widget Sample widget (public endpoint, rate limited to 10 requests/min per IP)
# Requires curl 7.76+ and jq.
BASE_URL="https://api.example.test/agents"
curl -sS --fail-with-body -X POST "$BASE_URL/v1/widgets/widget_1/public/invoke" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":{"message":"Hello"}}' | jq -r '.["response"]'
snippets.python:
# Call widget Sample widget (public endpoint, rate limited to 10 requests/min per IP)
# pip install requests
import os

import requests

BASE_URL = "https://api.example.test/agents"
HEADERS = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

res = requests.post(f"{BASE_URL}/v1/widgets/widget_1/public/invoke", headers=HEADERS, json={"input": {"message": "Hello"}}, timeout=120)
res.raise_for_status()
data = res.json()
print(data.get("response"))
